# verb-conservation record — project=go/secrets profile=pass
# every gate tool exits 0; each block is one verb: its exit code, then the argv
# of every external gate tool it invoked, in order.

### verb build
exit 0
go	build ./...

### verb test
exit 0
go	test ./... -race -count=1

### verb lint
exit 0
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s ./...

### verb vet
exit 0
go	vet ./...

### verb fmt
exit 0
gofumpt	-w .

### verb cover
exit 0
go	test -tags lifecycle load integration -coverpkg=./... ./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=<sandbox>/secrets-cover.<tmp> -count=1 EDEN_LOAD_N=50
go	tool cover -func=<sandbox>/secrets-cover.<tmp>

### verb property
exit 0
go	test ./... -race -count=1 -run .* RAPID_CHECKS=1000

### verb leak
exit 0
go	test ./... -count=1 -run .*

### verb lifecycle
exit 0
go	test -tags lifecycle ./... -race -count=1

### verb integration
exit 0
go	test -tags integration ./... -count=1

### verb load
exit 0
go	test -tags load ./... -race -count=1 EDEN_LOAD_N=500

### verb vuln
exit 0
govulncheck	./...

### verb sast
exit 0
gosec	-severity medium -quiet ./...

### verb secretscan
exit 0
gitleaks	detect --no-git --redact --source . --exit-code 1
go	test ./... -race -count=1 -run Canary|Redact|Secret

### verb bench
exit 127
go	test -run ^$ -bench=. -benchmem -count=10 ./...

### verb bench-guard
exit 0
go	test -run ^$ -bench=. -benchmem -count=10 ./...
benchstat	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets/.benchbaseline/hotpaths.txt <sandbox>/<tmp>

### verb bench-record
exit 127
go	test -run ^$ -bench=. -benchmem -count=10 ./...

### verb maintainability
exit 0
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s ./...
hnslint	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets

### verb mutate
exit 0

### verb cover-floor
exit 1
go	test -tags lifecycle load integration -coverpkg=./... ./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=<sandbox>/<tmp> -count=1 EDEN_LOAD_N=50

### verb apidiff
exit 0
go	list ./...

### verb apidiff-record
exit 0
go	list ./...

### verb phase-gate
exit 1
git	rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
git	rev-parse --show-toplevel
go	build ./...
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s ./...
hnslint	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets

### verb phase-gate architecture
exit 1
git	rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
git	rev-parse --show-toplevel
go	build ./...
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s ./...
hnslint	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets

### verb phase-gate implementation
exit 0
go	build ./...
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s ./...
hnslint	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets
go	list ./...
go	vet ./...
go	test ./... -race -count=1

### verb phase-gate testing
exit 1
go	test ./... -race -count=1
go	test ./... -race -count=1 -run .* RAPID_CHECKS=1000
go	test ./... -count=1 -run .*
go	test -tags lifecycle ./... -race -count=1
go	test -tags load ./... -race -count=1 EDEN_LOAD_N=500
go	test -tags integration ./... -count=1
go	test -run ^$ -bench=. -benchmem -count=10 ./...
benchstat	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets/.benchbaseline/hotpaths.txt <sandbox>/<tmp>
govulncheck	./...
gosec	-severity medium -quiet ./...
gitleaks	detect --no-git --redact --source . --exit-code 1
go	test ./... -race -count=1 -run Canary|Redact|Secret
go	test -tags lifecycle load integration -coverpkg=./... ./... -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=<sandbox>/<tmp> -count=1 EDEN_LOAD_N=50

### verb phase-gate qa
exit 1
gofumpt	-l .
go	vet ./...
golangci-lint	run --timeout=180s ./...
hnslint	<sandbox>/tree/go/secrets
